map.共济失调 SARA 评分器 使用指南: Ataxia SARA Scoring Tool User Guide
map.共济失调分级和评估量表(SARA)，评估共济失调严重程度，总分0-40分，分值越: Scale for the Assessment and Rating of Ataxia (SARA): rates ataxia severity on a 0-40 total score, where a higher value means more severe impairment
map.步态、站立、肢体协调量化。: Quantify gait, standing and limb coordination.
map.：步态 6+站立 4+坐位 3+言语 4+手指 3+鼻指 3+快速 3+跟膝胫: Gait 6 + standing 4 + sitting 3 + speech 4 + finger 3 + nose-finger 3 + rapid alternating movements 3 + heel-to-shin 3 = 29/40: moderate to severe ataxia.
map.：合计 10 /40：轻度，步态基本独立。: Total 10/40: mild, gait is largely independent.
map.8 项 max 8+6+4+6+4+4+4+4=40，越高共济失调越重。: 8 items, max 8+6+4+6+4+4+4+4=40; the higher the score, the more severe the ataxia.
map.对 SCA 基因型纵向随访敏感，可测年度进展。: Sensitive to longitudinal follow-up of the SCA genotype, so it can measure annual progression.
